fusions.name: Uprooting Blow
fusions.desc: A heavy swipe that deals 16 damage and leaves the target 15% easier to wound for 6 seconds. It has a 60% chance to leave the target [Caged] for 3 seconds. Your afflictions on the target spread to every enemy within 3 tiles.

fusions.name: Spore Spit
fusions.desc: Spits a spore that deals 7 damage and leaves the target [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 5 seconds. You heal for 15% of the damage dealt. You have 4 charges, and kills give them back.

fusions.name: Rootbed
fusions.desc: Raises a growth where you stand. For 10 seconds it restores 3 health a second to you and any ally inside it.

fusions.name: Taproot
fusions.desc: Each time you strike, you regain 2 health a second for 4 seconds. Once every 8 seconds.
